title: Static and Horizon
author: Rosalind Eastwick
blurb: Silas Nakamura, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
